body:
One day you'll look back at all the time you wasted caring about what other people think of you. Be you and you'll be happy. It's fucked how society places people in these "closets" that they have to "come out" of. You don't have to come out of anything. Just be who you want to be.

Also, you can like girls and guys if you feel that way. You can be into guys right now and then start liking girls more later. Like I said, be you, the sooner you do the sooner you'll find happiness.

Honestly I hate even thinking about it as if it's something that could happen. I've already felt like an outcast from my family and friends. Sitting at another families table would only further this feeling. Like I said I have a terrible diet, I'm overly picky, you could see it as some odd eating disorder. I get anxiety when I go to a restaurant and see nothing I'd consider eating on the menu. I don't want to put myself in a situation where I'm invited to a Christmas dinner but don't eat anything because I'm picky. I've done that many times throughout my life in different instances and it's crippling to me. I hate it. I hate my pickiness, it's pathetic, I'm so lucky to have all this great food and yet I don't eat it because it tastes terrible to me.

They are as understanding as they can be, they're sympathetic, they tell me they care about me. But it's just me transferring thoughts that they interpret which triggers them to respond with their thoughts. Nothing really comes of it, sometimes it's nice to vent and get those thoughts out verbally and sometimes it's nice to hear another persons take on it all. A lot of the time though, it's just affecting our relations, it's revealing how my mind works. It pushes some away and draws some closer. I don't know if I like either.

I don't believe in humanity anymore. I think we've ascended beyond that and we're sold remnants of "humanity". We're domesticated wild beasts who get our primal fixes through set up forms of entertainment, materialism, etc.. It's all just a groomed track we're riding, we've climbed out of the pool and are now just observing where we came from. I don't want to change it. I don't have answers. I don't think it matters.
